blocks.text: Ahead of the premiere of her horror film “VHS,” Sarah Lahbati spoke about her fears, catching netizens’ attention with her remarks about fictional dolls Barbie and Annabelle. In a conversation with film director Darryl Yap, shared on Viva Films’ Facebook page on Saturday, Oct. 10, Lahbati was asked, “Kanino ka mas natatakot, kay Annabelle o kay Barbie?” Barbie is a fashion doll introduced by American toy company Mattel, while Annabelle is a haunted doll from “The Conjuring” film franchise. “Si Barbie kasi na manika, maganda. Ganda lang siya e. Nung bata ako, ‘yun ‘yung nilalaro ko,” Lahbati said. “So I don’t think I would be scared of her.” “Pakiramdam ko mas nakakatakot si Annabell the doll because unpredictable siya sa pelikula.
